rationale: Detector, consolidation, and eligibility measurements overlap by construction.

All ten A2 supports are finally owned by GRAPHIC_FALLBACK with zero LINE, TEXT, LOGO, or SIGNATURE claims on the registered axis.
All ten lose native candidates at the text-filter boundary, so no case-specific structural topology reaches the later topology audit.
D2-006 participates in final contour and LINE geometry, but its final owner is still GRAPHIC_FALLBACK and that survival is not a discriminator applicable to the six missing A2 positives.
